title: Staff control panel — kayaks out & trip timeline (server-authoritative session tracking)
summary: Give dock staff a live board of which kayaks are on the water and for how long, plus a one-tap 'returned' action. Requires making rental sessions server-authoritative: the customer's 'Start route' tap (route-summary.js btnAccept) writes to a shared Cloudflare D1 DB via Pages Functions; the panel (a SEPARATE entry at /panel/, behind a shared staff passcode) reads it live. This also fixes the real bug where a reload/re-scan/dead-phone resets the customer's client-only timer. Full spec: SESSION-TRACKING-DESIGN.md. Human plan: docs/staff-panel.md. Work is split into 5 ordered phases; phases 0-2 deliver the visible board (demoable against seed data), phase 3 makes the data real, phase 4 polishes.

npm run db:init  (applies schema.sql to local D1).
npx wrangler pages dev app --port 8788  (serves customer app + Functions + local D1).
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8788/api/dev/seed  (fake kayaks in every state).
Open http://127.0.0.1:8788/panel/  -> log in with 1234 -> board.
verified: Schema applies to local D1; POST /api/dev/seed -> {ok:true,seeded:5}.
GET /api/panel/board without cookie -> 401; wrong passcode -> 401; correct passcode sets cookie; board returns correct shape.
Board sort: time_off (12,18) -> active by soonest expiry (03,07,09) -> available; second_device:true on 07; remaining_ms negative in time_off.
/panel/, panel.css, tokens.css, and all js/panel/*.js serve 200 with correct content-type.

discoveries: wrangler local: a local SQLite simulates D1 — wrangler.toml database_id is a placeholder ('REPLACE_WITH_D1_DATABASE_ID') and that is FINE for local dev; owner replaces it only for remote deploy.
.dev.vars (gitignored) holds local ALLOW_SEED/STAFF_PASSCODE/PANEL_SECRET; .dev.vars.example is the committed template.
Cookie auth: Set-Cookie omits `Secure` over http:// (local) and adds it over https:// — see makeSessionCookie in functions/_lib/auth.js.

Minor cosmetic: computeView's "menys d'1 min" branch is effectively unreachable for active (ceil of any positive sub-minute = 1, so it shows '1 min restants' then flips to time_off). Harmless; tidy if desired.
A wrangler dev server may still be running in the background from the build session (port 8788) — stop it if present.

decisions.data_source: Auto from QR scans (server-authoritative). NOT manual staff entry, NOT mock-only.
decisions.hosting: /panel/ path on the same Cloudflare Pages project (app/panel/index.html), shared staff passcode.
decisions.kayak_list: ['01'..'20'] static config array (20 per-kayak QRs, ?k=01..20). No kayak table.
decisions.durations: From the rental code (nav/code.js): 1 / 1.5 / 2 / 3 h => duration_min 60 / 90 / 120 / 180.
decisions.panel_lang: Catalan-only copy (local staff default) to keep it simple.
decisions.auth: POST /api/panel/login {passcode} vs STAFF_PASSCODE secret => HttpOnly signed (HMAC PANEL_SECRET) cookie; panel endpoints reject without it.

constraints.backend_was: Previously 100% static (app/server.py is a frozen dev static server, cannot run Functions). This phase ADDS Cloudflare Pages Functions + D1. server.py stays frozen; local panel dev uses `wrangler pages dev app`.
constraints.stack: Vanilla JS modules + plain CSS, no bundler/framework, ESM only (a missing named export blanks the whole app — check-esm-links.mjs pre-push hook). Panel is a SEPARATE ESM entry so a panel error can never white-screen the customer app.
constraints.graceful_degrade: If the API is unreachable the customer rental flow must keep working off localStorage exactly as today. The POST on session start is best-effort / fire-and-forget; server rehydrate falls back to the local session.
owner_only_steps: Create D1 DB + bind as `DB` to the Pages project (and wrangler.toml).
Apply schema.sql (wrangler d1 execute, local + remote).
Leave the seed endpoint env flag unset in production.

customer_app.nav/session.js: startSession/getSession/endSession/timeRemainingMs over localStorage 'sa-blava.session'; wall-clock countdown = startedAtMs + durationHours*3_600_000 - now.
customer_app.screens/route-summary.js: btnAccept handler (~line 152-177) calls startSession(...) at ~line 171 after tile pre-cache — THE hook point for POST /api/session/start.
customer_app.sw.js: fetch handler: non-GET passes through (POSTs safe); same-origin GET is network-first AND CACHED — must add early return for /api/ paths so board polls aren't cached. SHELL_CACHE currently 'sablava-shell-v20'.
